sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗马·马尔斯。

sentences.en: So earlier this month, we wrapped up the 99% Invisible Kickstarter fundraising campaign.
sentences.zh: 就在本月初，我们结束了99%隐形的Kickstarter众筹活动。

sentences.en: And it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: We had 5,661 backers and raised over $170,000.
sentences.zh: 我们有5,661名支持者，筹集了超过17万美元。

sentences.en: That was not what I was expecting.
sentences.zh: 这完全出乎我的意料。

sentences.en: So the huge show of support for the program made news around the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，节目收到的巨大支持登上了世界各地的新闻。

sentences.en: It was the highest earning journalism project in Kickstarter history.
sentences.zh: 这是Kickstarter历史上筹款最高的新闻项目。

sentences.en: So we're gearing up for Season 3.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在为第三季做准备。

sentences.en: And it won't be long.
sentences.zh: 而且很快就会到来。

sentences.en: It's going to be in September.
sentences.zh: 就在九月份。

sentences.en: So just a few weeks, couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 也就是再过几周，两周左右。

sentences.en: But I've got a few thousand envelopes to stuff.
sentences.zh: 但我还有几千个信封要装。

sentences.en: And we've got to get Sam unpacked and get everything sort of working in order now that we're together.
sentences.zh: 而且既然我们现在住在一起了，还得帮萨姆整理行李，把一切理顺。

sentences.en: And rather than doing repeats or just making you wait for the new season,
sentences.zh: 与其播放重播或者让你们干等新季度，

sentences.en: I'm going to present stories from producers that I love,
sentences.zh: 我打算为大家介绍一些我喜爱的制作人的故事，

sentences.en: but who didn't actually produce these stories from 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 但这些故事并非他们为99%隐形制作的。

sentences.en: But when you hear them, I'm pretty sure you're going to figure out why.
sentences.zh: 不过当你听到它们时，我很确定你会明白原因的。

sentences.en: Why I thought they'd be perfect for the show in terms of the subjects they cover
sentences.zh: 为什么我认为它们的主题非常适合这个节目，

sentences.en: and why I thought you'd love them too.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么我觉得你们也会喜欢它们。

sentences.en: Our first short story, very, very short story, is from Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个短篇故事，一个非常非常短的故事，来自爱尔兰。

sentences.en: It's a series called Language Bites.
sentences.zh: 这是一个名为“语言咬进”的系列。

sentences.en: Language Bites.
sentences.zh: 语言咬进。

sentences.en: Story.
sentences.zh: 故事。

sentences.en: Doors opening.
sentences.zh: 门正在打开。

sentences.en: Have you ever wondered why a level or floor on a building is called a story?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，为什么建筑物的层或楼会被称为“story”（故事）？

sentences.en: Doors closing.
sentences.zh: 门正在关闭。

sentences.en: That's a word we associate with a narrative or tale.
sentences.zh: 这是我们与叙事或传说联系在一起的词。

sentences.en: And actually, it's not far off the origin of the word we associate with architecture.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这与我们联想到建筑学的这个词的起源相差不远。

sentences.en: And its use takes us back to the 14th century.
sentences.zh: 它的使用可以追溯到14世纪。

sentences.en: Where are we going?
sentences.zh: 我们要去哪里？

sentences.en: The word story comes from the ancient Greek word historia, meaning account of events.
sentences.zh: “story”这个词源自古希腊语“historia”，意为对事件的记述。

sentences.en: In the 1300s, architects are in the habit of decorating buildings with stained glass
sentences.zh: 在1300年代，建筑师习惯用彩色玻璃装饰建筑，

sentences.en: and stone carvings or sculptures.
sentences.zh: 还有石雕或雕塑。

sentences.en: These carvings were on the outside of the building and they depicted actual stories.
sentences.zh: 这些雕刻位于建筑外部，它们描绘的是真实的故事。

sentences.en: Some of them recounted ancient myths and legends.
sentences.zh: 其中一些讲述了古代神话和传说。

sentences.en: And on churches and cathedrals, they often depicted Bible stories.
sentences.zh: 在教堂和大教堂上，它们经常描绘圣经故事。

sentences.en: So you can see where this is going.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出这是什么意思了。

sentences.en: The higher the building, the more stories it had.
sentences.zh: 建筑越高，它包含的“故事”就越多。

sentences.en: And eventually, the word story was used to refer to an entire floor or level.
sentences.zh: 最终，“story”这个词被用来指代整整一层楼或一个水平面。

sentences.en: First story.
sentences.zh: 第一层。

sentences.en: Language Bites is produced by Colette Kinsella.
sentences.zh: “语言咬进”由科莱特·金斯拉制作。

sentences.en: Sound design by Lachlan Hart.
sentences.zh: 声音设计由拉克兰·哈特负责。

sentences.en: The series was produced for and first broadcast on RTE Choice in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 该系列是为爱尔兰RTE Choice制作并首次广播的。

sentences.en: Our next short piece is from Nate Tameo in Memory Palace.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一个短篇来自《记忆宫殿》的内特·塔梅奥。

sentences.en: Nate produced episode number 27 of 99% Invisible long ago,
sentences.zh: 内特很久以前制作了99%隐形的第27集，

sentences.en: but his connection with the show does not end there.
sentences.zh: 但他与这个节目的联系并未止步于此。

sentences.en: Nate was one of the first people I called when I started 99% Invisible
sentences.zh: 内特是我创办99%隐形时打给的第一批人之一，

sentences.en: because essentially, I wanted to do stories like he was doing on the subject of history,
sentences.zh: 因为基本上，我想做类似于他在历史主题上所做的那种故事，

sentences.en: but I wanted to do them about architecture and design.
sentences.zh: 但我希望它们是关于建筑和设计的。

sentences.en: So if you're already familiar with 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你对99%隐形已经很熟悉，

sentences.en: you'll hear the shared DNA in our progenitor, the Memory Palace.
sentences.zh: 你会从我们的始祖《记忆宫殿》中听到共同的DNA。

sentences.en: This story is called Damn.
sentences.zh: 这个故事名叫《大坝》。

sentences.en: This is the Memory Palace.
sentences.zh: 这里是《记忆宫殿》。

sentences.en: I'm Nate Tameo.
sentences.zh: 我是内特·塔梅奥。

sentences.en: In 1931, at the height of the Depression,
sentences.zh: 1931年，正值大萧条的顶峰，

sentences.en: people began hearing that there were going to be jobs in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 人们开始听说内华达州将会有工作机会。

sentences.en: They needed men there to build an enormous dam
sentences.zh: 那里需要人手去建造一座巨大的水坝，

sentences.en: that would be named after President Herbert Hoover.
sentences.zh: 这座水坝将以赫伯特·胡佛总统的名字命名。

sentences.en: 5,000 men, former commodities traders, former obstetricians,
sentences.zh: 5,000名男子，曾经的大宗商品交易员、曾经的产科医生，

sentences.en: packed up their families and drove to the desert,
sentences.zh: 收拾行囊，带着家人驱车前往沙漠，

sentences.en: some of them leaving behind the plywood and scrap metal shantytowns
sentences.zh: 其中一些人抛弃了合板和废铁搭成的棚户区，

sentences.en: that were also named after Herbert Hoover.
sentences.zh: 这些棚户区也是以赫伯特·胡佛的名字命名的。

sentences.en: When they got there, they found that there were jobs,
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，发现确实有工作，

sentences.zh: 却还没建好。

sentences.en: So they hammered some posts into the ground
sentences.zh: 于是他们在地上钉了些柱子，

sentences.en: and strung up some sheets that could keep the desert sun off their kids and their wives,
sentences.zh: 挂上几块床单，好为妻儿遮挡沙漠的烈日，

sentences.en: and they went to work.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就投入了工作。

sentences.en: 96 of those men died
sentences.zh: 其中有96名工人失去了生命，

sentences.en: when the harnesses that fastened them to the canyon wall,
sentences.zh: 当将他们固定在峡谷岩壁上的安全带——

sentences.en: 800 feet in the air, snapped.
sentences.zh: 身处800英尺的高空——突然断裂时。

sentences.en: When the hearts of 50-year-old men who were used to selling women's hosiery
sentences.zh: 当那些习惯了卖女性长袜的50岁男人们的心脏，

sentences.en: were teaching geometry.
sentences.zh: 或者曾经教几何的男人们的心脏。

sentences.en: When their hearts gave out after working 10-hour shifts in 130-degree heat,

sentences.en: chipping a mile-long tunnel beneath the desert, inch by inch.
sentences.zh: 一英寸一英寸地在沙漠下凿出长达一英里的隧道时。

sentences.en: When others fell into wet concrete and had to be pulled out.

sentences.en: Not before they died,
